title: Hearty Lentil Stew
description: A comforting, slow-cooked stew made with red lentils, Jamaican spices, and a touch of velvety texture.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add onion and garlic, cook until softened.
Add curry powder, cook for 1 minute.
Add lentils, carrot, and potato, cook for 5 minutes.
Add broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 30 minutes.
Stir in coconut milk and cook for an additional 10 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs.
Optional: Serve with crusty bread or over rice.
